## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 209 user-facing changes.
### Improved
- Position torn-off windows where you drop the tab, keeping the window within the display - Choose folder icons from the full searchable SF Symbols catalog - Read tinted folder titles more easily with semibold text and stronger contrast - Fade smoothly between pinned-tab outline colors as website colors become available
### Fixed
- Keep pages loaded when you switch to them in another window during memory cleanup - Keep extension and built-in pages on their own device so they cannot block iCloud sync - Keep the Mac sidebar collapsed when opening the address editor with Command-L - Match the system dark background across Crest's app icon color palettes - Keep wide folder symbols fully visible in Icon only mode - Keep pinned-tab colors consistent when pages unload and use more representative website colors - Use favicon colors for pinned outlines when websites declare black, white, or neutral theme colors - Keep black, white, and gray favicon colors in pinned-tab outlines
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 39 user-facing changes.
### Improved
- Reorder Spaces directly in Settings with Up and Down controls - Reduce unnecessary icon and thumbnail redraws while adjusting Space appearance - Use Liquid Glass controls for reordering and adding Spaces - Keep a visible gap between tab highlights at the default spacing - Drag individual tabs out of a split, or move the whole split from its header - Keep Peeks with their tabs while opening new tabs, switching Spaces, and browsing inside the Peek - Blend address bar colors with the background when switching Spaces
### Fixed
- Keep Space appearance settings responsive while scrolling - Keep Settings actions within the current unlocked Space and protect locked destinations - Recover missing iCloud changes with a confirmed Pull from iCloud action, and keep blank tabs from blocking Space and tab updates - Search selected text in a new Crest tab using the current Space’s search engine - Prevent a crash when displaying sidebar previews during setup
---
Nightly builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 56 user-facing changes.
### New
- Use custom search engines with website icons and optional search suggestions in each Space - See update availability and control media from a global sidebar widget deck across Spaces
### Improved
- Follow new downloads into Downloads and see live size, progress, speed, and time remaining across Mac and iPhone
### Fixed
- Show blocked pop-ups in Site Controls with a one-step allow action - Keep loading pages on-brand, reuse an open Start Page, and search tabs only in the current Space - Keep Space navigation centered and Archive controls reachable as more Spaces are added - Continue typing with the same caret or selection after returning to a webpage tab on Mac - Use compatible browser extension actions directly from webpage context menus - Keep mouse back and forward navigation within the webpage or sidebar under the pointer - Keep new-window links inside Peek and Quick Window instead of hiding them in background tabs - Start loading tabs opened from links right away, with an option to select them automatically - Refresh available updates to the newest eligible build before downloading
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.
